subtitle: Courses Adapted by Age
desc: Our curriculum is pedagogically structured to accompany the cognitive development of each student.
section_kids_desc: For curious minds taking their first steps in technology and logic.
section_teens_desc: Real programming and robotics challenges for the creators of tomorrow.
section_adults_desc: Career change, automation, and industry-leading technologies.
kids_c1_desc: In this workshop, kids learn about the fundamental bases of electronics, robotics, and programming. They will learn by creating small robots that they will program to achieve their goals. The complete course is structured in several workshops of 2 weeks each, so that each child can do it at their own pace.
kids_c2_desc: In this workshop, kids learn about the fundamental concepts of programming, with simple and guided exercises, then move on to develop their own animations and finally video games using the programming elements learned.
kids_c3_desc: A one-and-a-half-hour workshop designed as a first technological approach for events and birthday parties. A unique experience that invites kids to awaken curiosity about technology.
teens_c1_desc: In this workshop, teens will learn the fundamentals of automation and industrial control, using the fundamental concepts of robotics to solve real-world problems.
teens_c2_desc: In this course, teens will learn to work with industrial programming languages, such as Python and JavaScript, creating systems with graphical web interfaces and database connections.
teens_c3_desc: If you are thinking of entering college in an engineering or technology career, we help you prepare for admission exams.
adults_c1_desc: A series of workshops that will take you to program from scratch, focusing on the fundamental concepts of software development.
adults_c2_desc: Geared towards students and professionals who need to learn a specific technology. These workshops will allow you to learn the theoretical and practical concepts behind each tool or methodology and put them into practice in your classes or work.
adults_c3_desc: We build tailored programs for companies, combining workshops, events, and technological team-building activities to boost team training.
